meta.description: Portfolio of Kaori, a software engineer.

description.aim: I build software in the hope that it can add a little color to people's everyday lives.
description.focus: I focus on designing and architecting frontend code (AI-friendly code, UI component libraries, and design systems), and on building pleasant, effective teams.

cleanCode.heading: The Role of the Frontend
cleanCode.body: The frontend is an important interface that connects users and data. I have a feeling that presenting AI output as HTML makes it easier for people to understand. I belive this is a field where engineers with deep expertise can use AI agents to reach areas that used to be hard to tackle.　I also find it rewarding to build UIs for AI-powered services.

philosophy.heading: Production Releases
philosophy.body: Releases always make me nervous. To turn them into something I look forward to, I keep improving our workflow day by day. Right now, I'm interested in building workflow that incorporate AI agents.

team.heading: Teamwork
team.body: One of the things I value most at work is the team. Because I also build thins on my own, I truly appreciate what it means to have teammates.

extra.heading: Extra
extra.lead: I write a tech blog and work on a personal project.
extra.closing: This portfolio is my playground. I update it at a relaxed pace, the way someone might enjoy knitting.
